name: Echo Wisp
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
description: An Echo Wisp is a pale mote of lingering memory given a ghostly, willful shape. In the dim corridors of Numillian, it drifts like a lantern flame seen through frosted glass, its body no larger than a fist and forever trembling at the edges. At its core glows a soft silver-blue light, but that light is wrapped in thin ribbons of translucent mist that unfurl into fleeting afterimages: a hand reaching for a sealed door, a face half-remembered, a line of script dissolving before it can be read. When it moves, it leaves a faint trail of whispering sound, like old footsteps crossing polished stone or a voice speaking from the other side of a wall. These wisps are drawn to wards, records, and places steeped in repetition and loss, hovering near memory-slates, locked reliquaries, and shattered thresholds as if listening for the shape of forgotten truths. They rarely attack openly; instead, they flicker through cracks, distract the eye, and tug at the mind with a sensation of déjà vu and unease. In the moonlit dust of a ruin or the lantern glow of the Curated Quarter, an Echo Wisp feels less like a monster and more like a thought that refused to die.
